operation.summary: A bundled manufacturer logo, as GET /v1/lan/brands/{id}/logo, without the Network discovery switch. For the owner's Bridgit app on iPhone & iPad, over the relay; read-only.

query.name: client
query.description: Optional: the viewing device, e.g. iPhone, iPad or Android (1-24 letters, digits, space . _ -). The phone's Home shows it as the device viewing it

operation.returns: id, name, logo_url, mime, data_base64 (or the image with raw=1)
